features.feature_value: Advocacy framed as imperative slogan with opposite action verbs (REJECT vs DEFEND)
features.evidence_span: "REJECT Planned Parenthood: Discrimination shouldn’t be funded by taxpayers" / "DEFEND Planned Parenthood: Healthcare rights shouldn't be stripped by government zealots"
features.rationale: The post uses a direct directive (imperative) to take a stance, and the mirror flips the advocated action.

features.feature_value: Ends with anti-propaganda contrast phrase (Data/Evidence over Lies/Propaganda)
features.rationale: A clear argumentative contrast positions one side as truthful and the other as misleading.

features.feature_value: Causal/attribution claim blaming “sabotage” while asserting policy success
features.evidence_span: "Despite a brutal political sabotage... it’s falling." / "Despite vicious corporate lobbying and Republican obstruction... workers are actually seeing real gains."
features.rationale: The wording asserts causal responsibility and attributes changes to political obstruction.

features.feature_value: National awareness month with educational/supportive call content
features.evidence_span: "June is National Gun Violence Awareness Month. Learn how to recognize warning signs, support others, and help build safer schools"
features.rationale: The post centers on a named recurring observance and provides guidance on recognizing and responding to risk.

features.feature_value: Uses symbol punctuation and community-safety language (“& communities”)
features.rationale: The text uses community-building phrasing and an HTML entity ampersand as part of the promotional message style.

features.feature_value: If/then-style conditional logic: remove one element → dead letter; ballot/local races emphasized
features.evidence_span: "Remove any one and it's a dead letter. The local offices you skip on the ballot matter most."
features.rationale: The post uses a conditional structure to argue that success depends on multiple coordinated actors.

features.feature_value: Claims government “tyranny” against people without guns/critics; mirror shifts blame to gun owners enabling terror
features.evidence_span: "the USA government is committing the tyranny over." / "helping the government terrorize the rest of us"
features.rationale: The rhetoric establishes an adversarial us-vs-them framing centered on oppression/terror and shifts target direction in the mirror.

features.feature_value: Strong profanity/expletive plus escalating negative evaluation (“Holy shit… fucked”)
features.evidence_span: "Holy shit. Those people are so fucked."
features.rationale: The post is highly expressive and uses blunt insult language rather than policy discussion.
